rawContent: That's why as much of a supporter I am for #BlackLivesMatter and for #BidenHarris2020 I wasn't putting either decal on my car. Especially after seeing how they did the Biden/Harris bus a few months ago. I leave my car unattended way too much, and people nowadays are crazy.

Honestly the only thing I can ever say the police has done for me was give me 3 tickets. Far as that nothing else. No peace of mind, no protection, anything. I feel more scared and uneasy around them, than I do safe.

R.I.P to #Makiyahbryant #SayHerName #BlackLivesMatter
